rv.q: Ultimately and somewhat disappointingly, though, White Christmas left me with lukewarm cockles and a half-melted heart.
Laden with great routines and good humour, it had what this stage adaptation signally lacks, and that's lightness of touch.
If you need a production to get you in the Christmas spirit, then book tickets – the final sing-a-long of White Christmas is sure to warm the cockles.

cn.t: This lavish, sentimental adaptation of the 1954 film delivers festive cheer and Irving Berlin's beloved songs, but critics find its gentle, old-fashioned structure struggles to achieve the monumental yuletide magic it aims for.
